# Support

Thank you for using [KloudKIT](https://kloudkit.com) 🎉.
These are community-driven, open-source projects; **we do not provide commercial support**.

## Community Support

| Inquiry             | Channel                                  |
| ------------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| 📚 Documentation     | The repository's README                  |
| 🐞 Bugs / Ideas      | The repository's GitHub Issues           |
| 🔒 Sensitive issues  | <info@kloud.email>                       |

**Kloud Workspace** *(the `workspace` and `ws-*` repositories)* has its docs at
<https://ws.kloudkit.com>, and takes questions, ideas and bugs in [ws-meta][]
*([Discussions][] or [Issues][])*.

For contribution guidelines, see [CONTRIBUTING.md][].

[ws-meta]: https://github.com/kloudkit/ws-meta
[Discussions]: https://github.com/kloudkit/ws-meta/discussions
[Issues]: https://github.com/kloudkit/ws-meta/issues
[CONTRIBUTING.md]: https://github.com/kloudkit/.github/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md
